{{Quote|She was in a cell near ours. For a while. Nice girl. Confused by her imprisonment. Said the general referred to her as a ''loose end''. The general killed her. Shot her himself, in front of us. He told us, 'This is what I’ll do to someone I love. I did it to attain my objective. '''Keura Fallatte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At age sixteen, she left her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to live the life of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. Three [[Standard year|years]] later, she left her work and settled at a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] hostel. She was romantically linked to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] in [[44 ABY]]. However, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] her in front of a pair of prisoners to prove his devotion to his objective of establishing a private empire.<ref name="MK" />
